description: This Java source file defines an interface `JsonInternalVisitor` used for traversing JSON structures and converting them into a generic type `T`. It provides methods for different JSON primitives and composite types, as well as a default method `eval` to recursively process a `JsonValue` and produce a `T` representation.

classes.name: JsonInternalVisitor
classes.description: A package-private interface for visiting JSON structures, transforming them into a generic type T.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Returns the representation of a JSON null.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Returns the representation of a JSON boolean value.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Returns the representation of a JSON string value.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Returns the representation of a JSON number value.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Constructs the representation of a JSON array from a stream of element representations.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Constructs the representation of a JSON object from a stream of key-value pairs.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Recursively evaluates a `JsonValue`, converting it into the type `T` using the visitor methods.
